10.01.2025
 14.
Ct. No. 28
 Sg
[Allowed]
 C. R. M. (A) 1 of 2025

In Re: An application for anticipatory bail under Section 482 of  the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 in connection  with Bhagwangola Police Station Case No. 391 of 2024 dated  29.07.2024 under Section 376(3) of IPC read with Section 6 of

entities.text: Bhagwangola Police Station Case No. 391 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
. 
 And  In Re: XXXX.
 ... ... Petitioner  Mr. Md. Bani Israil,
 Mr. Sayed Md. Sayud.
 .... for the petitioner  Ms. Minoti Gomes,
 Mr. Sobhan Gani.
 .... for the State  1.
Inadvertent typographical errors had crept into the order dated 03.01.2025.
2.

In the cause title of the order dated 03.01.2025 the name of the learned Advocate for the State be read as 'Ms. Minoti Gomes with Mr. Sobhan Gani' in place and stead of 'Mr. Debasish Roy'.
3.
Heard learned Advocates for the parties.
4. We have considered the materials on record.
In her statement she submits she had eloped with the petitioner.
5. Keeping in mind the aforesaid facts, we are inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

6. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-, with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer and also subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
He shall appear before the jurisdictional court and pray for regular bail within four weeks from date.
